['Bertelsmann SE & Co. KGaA '].company_description: Bertelsmann SE & Co. KGaA is a German private multinational conglomerate corporation based in Gütersloh, Germany. It is one of the world's largest media conglomerates and operates in the media, service, and education sectors. Its divisions include the RTL Group, Penguin Random House, BMG, Arvato, Bertelsmann Printing Group, Bertelsmann Education Group, and Bertelsmann Investments.

['Adolf W\u00fcrth GmbH & Co. KG'].company_description: Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG is a worldwide wholesaler of fasteners, screws and screw accessories, dowels, chemicals, electronic and electromechanical components, furniture and construction fittings, tools, machines, installation material, automotive hardware, inventory management, storage and retrieval systems. They serve industries such as Automotive, Woodworking, Metalworking, Industrial, and Construction. The company was founded in 1945 by Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG and is currently led by his son Reinhold Würth.
